_comment: Single source of truth for which model GLBs are served from the asset-pack cloud instead of the phone bundle. Read by src/modelUrl.ts (resolver), scripts/build-asset-packs.mjs (what to publish), and vite.config.ts (what to drop from bucket-mode builds). A file here must have EVERY consumer routed through modelUrl (CubeTab3D + modelSprite today) or it 404s on device; keep it to models whose loaders are all routed.
